source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check if supported OS can be installed onto single M.2 and booted successfully.

1. Install the primary OS to M.2.
2. Reboot system to check boot function and OS logs.
3. Check Front Panel HDD LED (If have for Tower Server) status.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. should no error message related to M.2.
2. Front HDD LED status should be OFF without IO operation.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Assist with non-interactive install arguments at user direction.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: OS boots from M.2 and drive visibility evidence.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies media and formatting risk but omits exact target/boot controls and the manual front-panel LED criterion.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds target allowlisting, media/boot-mode validation, formatting approval, logs and manual LED evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 baseline record exists; exact row and V2 were independently reviewed.

original_test_intent: Install the supported primary OS onto one explicitly designated M.2 device, boot from that same device without M.2-related errors and, on applicable tower systems, visually verify that the front-panel HDD LED is off when no I/O is occurring.
original_method: A qualified operator approves the exact M.2 target and installer/boot recipe; an unattended or supervised deployment installs the OS and reboots; automation verifies boot-device identity and logs, while the operator establishes an idle I/O condition and visually records the applicable front HDD LED state.
manual_activity: OS deployment and boot/log collection can be automated after target approval, but the source includes front-panel HDD LED state as a formal acceptance criterion. A human must establish/confirm the applicable physical LED and visually attest it is off at idle; the agent cannot claim that observation, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Exact M.2 slot/serial/namespace and explicit authorization to erase/install
Supported OS edition/version/media hash, license/configuration and unattended or interactive recipe
Boot mode, storage driver, partition layout, boot-order and recovery/restore plan
Tower-server applicability, exact front-panel LED mapping and measurable idle/no-I/O precondition
Qualified operator, KVM/OOB, stable power and maintenance/reboot window
safety_requirements: Never partition, format or install to an inferred, mounted, in-use, protected, OS or data device; positively revalidate the allowlisted serial immediately before write.
Preserve existing partition/boot inventory and backup evidence; do not clear logs as part of the generic preamble.
Stop on target mismatch, installer/storage error, failed boot, unexpected boot entry, M.2 error or anomalous LED behavior.
Do not auto-retry installation, select another drive, alter boot settings or claim LED state from software activity counters.
agent_execution_scope: Validate installer, exact target, partition/boot and recovery manifest and capture pre-install storage/boot inventory.
After approval, assist or execute the supported unattended installation and one controlled reboot if the plan permits, then collect boot-device, M.2 health and OS-log evidence.
Correlate operator-attributed idle LED photo/video with I/O telemetry and report Tool Result without claiming the observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact erase target, OS recipe, boot changes and restore plan.
Visually inspect and attest the applicable front HDD LED under the defined no-I/O condition.
Review installation, boot, log and LED evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level non-interactive-install assistance is possible but not a complete method; it omits target identity, exact recipe, boot verification and the manual LED acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the project-approved deployment mechanism only after immutable target allowlisting. Read-only boot/log commands supplement, but cannot replace, the operator's LED observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Single-M.2 primary OS installation, reboot/boot-log check, conditional tower LED check and 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: AUTOMATED DEPLOYMENT PLUS MANUAL LED ACCEPTANCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed deployment manifest with serial-bound destructive targeting, installer transcript, boot-entry and root-device proof, M.2 log/health checks, and timestamped operator LED evidence synchronized with verified zero/idle I/O.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Approved M.2 target, OS/boot architecture and tower LED wiring only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS installer, kernel/driver, BIOS/BMC, drive firmware and deployment-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project OS support matrix, deployment SOP and chassis LED specification must be supplied.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target-safe automation and correlates physical LED observation with idle I/O without replacing it.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful boot, clean M.2 logs and applicable LED-off behavior remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Software can confirm I/O counters but not the physical LED's emitted state or chassis mapping.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose its supported OS, target, partition and install mechanism. If the chassis has no applicable front HDD LED, record the conditional criterion as not applicable with owner evidence rather than silently omitting it.
expected_evidence: M.2 slot/serial/namespace and pre-install partition/mount/boot inventory, OS media hash/recipe and authorization
Complete installer/deployment transcript and resolved target/partition changes
Successful reboot with root/boot device bound to the designated M.2 plus health and M.2-related OS logs
Idle-I/O telemetry and operator-attributed front LED photo/video or documented N/A, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require M.2 installation/boot health and conditional tower front-HDD-LED behavior. Boot success is stated in the procedure intent even though the concise criteria emphasize logs and LED.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The installation and visual acceptance are clear. Missing media, target or LED applicability are readiness inputs; the human LED criterion makes the complete case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains formatting risk and deployment assistance but rejects PARTIAL because formal LED acceptance is human visual work.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains exact target, media, boot and LED controls while applying the strict V3.1 MANUAL ONLY rule for a human-observed criterion.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automatable install/boot evidence from the non-delegable LED observation and defines conditional N/A handling.

review_improvement: Prevents wrong-disk installation and prevents an automated boot result from being misreported as completion of the physical LED criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Most of the workflow can be automated, but the complete source acceptance explicitly includes a physical front-panel LED observation. Under the locked classification rule, a human-observed core criterion makes the case MANUAL ONLY rather than PARTIAL or FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
